name: Benin
description: Benin from the kingdom of Dahomey and the slave coast to French rule, independence in 1960, Marxism and a democracy since 1991.

checkpoints.name: Dahomey
checkpoints.note: The kingdom of Dahomey rose at Abomey and grew rich in the slave trade, with a famous female regiment.

checkpoints.name: French Dahomey
checkpoints.note: France conquered Dahomey in 1894 and ruled it as part of French West Africa.

checkpoints.name: Independent Benin
checkpoints.note: Independence came in 1960. Kérékou's Marxist state ended with the national conference of 1990, and Benin became a democracy.
